title: Elated or Jubilant? The English Happiness Scale #shorts
text:
Do you know the difference between elated and jubilant? 🤔

Melancholy and wistful are soft sadness. Morose adds bad temper, despondent adds hopelessness.

title: Formal or Informal Anger Words? (IELTS Tip) #shorts
text:
Which anger words are formal enough for an IELTS essay? 🤔

Informal: irked, livid
Formal: indignant, incensed, irate

Prepositions matter:
furious WITH a person, ABOUT a thing
resentful OF someone's success
exasperated WITH a person

💬 Write a sentence with the right preposition 👇

Paramount = the most important of all → safety is paramount

title: My Boss Was Very Angry → IRATE! Level Up + Sound Polite #shorts

title: 3 Essay Starters That Sound Academic (Copy These!) #shorts
text:
Want 3 essay starters you can copy right now? ✍️

Word families: pivot → pivotal · disparity → disparate · exhaustive → exhaustively · indispensable ↔ dispensable

Ephemeral = time (disappears fast). Tenuous = strength (weak, could break).

Essay starters:
• It is paramount that…
• A pivotal factor in … is…
• There is a stark disparity between…
